offers_products.reason: Licenses embedded and cloud AI software: in-car voice assistant, Cerence xUI, emergency vehicle detection shipped in cars.

offers_services.reason: Also provides connected cloud services, professional services and Dealer Assist Agent; but software licensing is larger part.

sells_to_consumers.reason: Sells to automakers, Tier-1s and dealerships; drivers use it but OEMs choose and buy.

sells_to_organizations.reason: Customers are 80+ automotive OEMs and Tier-1 suppliers, plus dealerships and enterprises.

recurring_revenue.reason: Most revenue is per-vehicle licence royalties and project-based fees tied to car production, though connected services recur.

cyclical_demand.reason: Royalties depend on new car production volumes, which fall in downturns; automakers can delay development projects.

big_ticket.reason: Per-vehicle licence fees are small and frequent, accruing with each car shipped.

people_delivered.reason: Customers pay for software and AI technology embedded in vehicles, not mainly staff time.

large_customers.reason: Main customers are large global automakers and Tier-1 suppliers.

asset_heavy.reason: Software licensing business needing R&D and cloud, not plants, fleets or networks.
